Viśrāntanyāsa

Viśrāntavidyādhara
gr. prob. by Vāmana. q. in Nyāsa on the Bṛhadvṛtti of Hemacandra, Ind. Ant. 1886; also Belvalkar, [Page36-b] Systems of Skt. Gr. p. 147b; also see Y. Mimamsak, Saṃ. Vyā. kā Itihās, Vol. II. p. 106.

Viśrāntavidyāvinoda
med. a work on veterinary surgery attributed to King Bhoja. q. by Bhāva Miśra, see Ind. Ant. Vol. II. 1873. p. 304.

Viśrānti_Varman

Viśrāmaratna

Viśrāma_Śarman

Viśrāma_Śukla

Viśrāma-stotraviṃśatiprakāśa
a description of 20 diff. subjects auch a. Bhavana etc. acc. to the theory of Svetāmbara Jains. by Paṇḍita Hemacandrācārya. Kāśin. 44.

Viśrāmātmaja
